intro: Jobs similar to massage therapists are hands-on health and wellness careers. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Acupuncturists (83% similar), Physical Therapists (81%) and Chiropractors (80%). Most of them need far more schooling than massage therapy.
shared: These careers share touch-based treatment, listening to how a patient feels and building trust over many visits. O*NET rates social perceptiveness and service orientation at 3.12 out of 5 for massage therapists. Acupuncture, physical and occupational therapy and athletic training rely on the same care. Most of the top matches need a graduate degree, so the realistic short steps are therapy assistant jobs.

faq.q: Which jobs like massage therapist pay more?
faq.a: 13 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Physical Therapists earn $102,760 (76% more) and Occupational Therapists $100,330 (72% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Both usually need a graduate degree, unlike the $58,450 massage therapy path, which most people enter through a certificate program.

faq.q: What jobs like massage therapy pay more without a degree?
faq.a: 2 of the 20 similar careers pay more with no more preparation: Occupational Therapy Assistants and Physical Therapist Assistants. Both usually need an associate degree and a license, and they apply the same hands-on care in clinics, rehabilitation centers and hospitals under a licensed therapist.
